## Module to write
path: StarterPlayerScripts/FeatureVerifyClient.client.luau
purpose: Feature: Add executable checks and fix failures for: the SHOP button opens a panel listing every Upgrades entry with price and affordability, and buying Dropper 2 for 10 works once; the rebirth altar appears at 5000 cash or when all upgrades are owned, and rebirth applies the multiplier and resets cash and upgrades; the plaza TOP TYCOONS board lists Cash and Rebirths; the tutorial arrow and banner appear after the first claim and advance on the first purchase. Mark each feature verified when its checks pass. -- Client-side probe that stays inert unless the verify remotes exist (it WaitForChilds them with a timeout and exits on nil). On request from the server it inspects the player's own UI and replies with plain data. For SHOP, it finds the SHOP button in PlayerGui, activates it, and returns whether the panel is visible plus the list of cards (UpgradeId, price text, Affordable attribute). For TUTORIAL, it returns whether the banner and arrow are visible. It sends no gameplay intent to the server. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: feature_verified_shop, feature_verified_rebirth, feature_verified_board, feature_verified_tutorial.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/FeatureChecksConfig.luau, StarterPlayerScripts/ShopUi.client.luau, StarterPlayerScripts/TutorialGuide.client.luau

Sound names: Coin, Buy, Gem, Click, Pop, Error, Whoosh, Jump, Land, Boom, Splash, Hurt, Win, Music. Director sounds: Coin->Coin, Buy->Buy, Click->Click, Pop->Pop, Error->Error, Whoosh->Whoosh, Land->Land, Win->Win, Boom->Boom, Music->Music
- Juice: cube collected: soft short Coin tick, collector flashes bright yellow, tiny sparkle at the intake, floating +$N rises over the collector; HUD cash punches and ticks up; cube dropped: none (silent so it does not spam), small puff and a squash tween on the dropper nozzle; BuyPad affordable: pad turns green and pulses with a brighter Neon glow, PriceBillboard turns green and the HUD goal bar fills; upgrade purchased: Buy confirm chime, pad pops and vanishes, the new model rises with a Back tween, a sparkle burst follows, cash counter punches, Toast 'Unlocked: Dropper 2!', small shake; not enough cash: Error buzz, pad flashes red briefly, price text shakes, Toast 'Need $X more'; ore tier upgrade (Silver/Gold/Diamond): Win sting, cubes change to the new colour with a gem-coloured shockwave ring at the dropper, RewardPopup 'GOLD ORE! $30 per cube', medium shake and brief FOV punch; shop opened: Whoosh, dim backdrop fades in, Panel scales in with a Back tween; buy buttons punch on click with a Click sound; shop purchase: Buy, button flashes green and the card's level bar fills, level x/max ticks up and cash counter punches; multiplier bought: Win, the collector glows and its multiplier sign flips to 'x2', HUD income readout flashes and gets bigger for a moment, small shake; rebirth: Boom followed by Win, white flash, confetti and gold sparkle burst, plot rebuilds with a rise tween, RewardPopup 'REBIRTH! x1.5 forever'; Rebirths stat increases, large shake and FOV punch; tutorial step complete: Pop, arrow bursts into sparkles and re-appears on the next target, Toast with the next hint; leaderboard refresh: the player's row is highlighted with a soft glow, board entries slide to their new ranks

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Do not give starting cash equal to the first upgrade's price. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. Start slightly below the price so the first few collected cubes earn it, within about 10s.
- The first purchase must actually happen in a short playtest, and its counters (e.g. upgrades_bought) must be above 0. If the report lacks them, the first pad is too hard to find or reach. Put it close to the claimed plot's spawn point, off the walking path, and guide the player to it with a beam. Make sure the tutorial step that points to it fires.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Give failure feedback as well as success feedback. A pad or button pressed without enough cash needs a red flash, an audible buzz and a "Need $N" toast, debounced to about 1s. A silent denial confuses young players.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally. They must still be easy to find and reach: guide the player to the first pad with a visible beam or arrow.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.

```luau
--!strict
-- FeatureVerifyClient: inert client probe. Stays idle unless the server created the verify remotes.
-- On request it inspects the player's own UI / visible world state and replies with plain data.
-- It never sends gameplay intent. (ForgeTelemetry is a no-op on the client, so the server bumps
-- the feature_verified_* counters when it receives passing results.)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	return
end

local configModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FeatureChecksConfig", 10)
if not configModule then
	return
end
local Config = require(configModule) :: any

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.Folder, 10)
if not remotes then
	return
end
local req = remotes:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.VerifyRequest, 10)
local res = remotes:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.VerifyResponse, 10)
if not req or not res or not req:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not res:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
	return
end

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
if not playerGui then
	return
end

local featureSet: { [string]: boolean } = {}
for _, id in ipairs(Config.FeatureOrder) do
	featureSet[id] = true
end

-- A GuiObject counts as shown if it and every ancestor GUI container is visible/enabled.
local function isShown(inst: Instance?): boolean
	local cur = inst
	while cur and cur ~= playerGui do
		if cur:IsA("ScreenGui") or cur:IsA("BillboardGui") or cur:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			if not (cur :: any).Enabled then
				return false
			end
		elseif cur:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if not cur.Visible then
				return false
			end
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return cur ~= nil
end

local function findShopButton(): GuiButton?
	local named = playerGui:FindFirstChild(Config.Gui.ShopButton, true)
	if named and named:IsA("GuiButton") then
		return named
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextButton") and string.upper(d.Text):find("SHOP") then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function activate(btn: GuiButton)
	local fs = (getfenv() :: any).firesignal
	if type(fs) == "function" then
		pcall(fs, btn.Activated)
		pcall(fs, btn.MouseButton1Click)
	end
end

local function findPanel(): Instance?
	local gui = playerGui:FindFirstChild(Config.Gui.ShopGui)
	if gui then
		return gui:FindFirstChild(Config.Gui.ShopPanel, true) or gui
	end
	return nil
end

local function collectCards(panel: Instance): { any }
	local cards = {}
	local attrs = Config.Gui.ShopCardAttributes
	for _, d in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
		local id = d:GetAttribute(attrs.UpgradeId)
		if id ~= nil then
			local priceText = ""
			for _, t in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
				if t:IsA("TextLabel") or t:IsA("TextButton") then
					if string.find(t.Text, "%$") then
						priceText = t.Text
						break
					end
				end
			end
			local price = d:GetAttribute(attrs.Price)
			if priceText == "" and type(price) == "number" then
				priceText = "$" .. tostring(price)
			end
			table.insert(cards, {
				UpgradeId = tostring(id),
				PriceText = priceText,
				Price = price,
				Affordable = d:GetAttribute(attrs.Affordable),
			})
		end
	end
	return cards
end

local function probeShop(): any
	local btn = findShopButton()
	local data: any = { buttonFound = btn ~= nil, panelVisible = false, cards = {}, activated = false }
	if not btn then
		return data
	end
	local panel = findPanel()
	local wasShown = panel ~= nil and isShown(panel)
	if not wasShown then
		activate(btn)
		data.activated = type(((getfenv() :: any).firesignal)) == "function"
		task.wait(0.6)
		panel = findPanel()
	end
	if panel then
		data.panelVisible = isShown(panel)
		data.cards = collectCards(panel)
	end
	if not wasShown and data.panelVisible then
		activate(btn) -- restore the closed state
	end
	return data
end

local function probeTutorial(): any
	local g = Config.Gui
	local banner = playerGui:GetAttribute(g.TutorialBannerAttribute)
	local arrow = playerGui:GetAttribute(g.TutorialArrowAttribute)
	local step = playerGui:GetAttribute(g.TutorialStepAttribute)
	local tgui = playerGui:FindFirstChild(g.TutorialGui)
	if banner == nil and tgui then
		banner = isShown(tgui) and #tgui:GetDescendants() > 0
	end
	if step == nil and tgui then
		step = tgui:GetAttribute(g.TutorialStepAttribute)
	end
	return { bannerVisible = banner == true, arrowVisible = arrow == true, step = step }
end

local function probeRebirth(): any
	local btn = playerGui:FindFirstChild(Config.Gui.RebirthButton, true)
	local altarVisible = false
	for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(inst.Name, 1, #Config.World.AltarName) == Config.World.AltarName then
			local owner = inst:GetAttribute(Config.World.AltarOwnerAttribute)
			if owner == nil or owner == player.UserId then
				altarVisible = true
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		buttonFound = btn ~= nil,
		buttonVisible = btn ~= nil and isShown(btn),
		altarVisible = altarVisible,
	}
end

local function probeBoard(): any
	local board = workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.World.BoardName, true)
	local texts = {}
	if board then
		for _, d in ipairs(board:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
				table.insert(texts, d.Text)
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		exists = board ~= nil,
		texts = texts,
		showsCash = board and board:GetAttribute(Config.World.BoardCashAttribute),
		showsRebirths = board and board:GetAttribute(Config.World.BoardRebirthsAttribute),
	}
end

local probes: { [string]: () -> any } = {
	shop = probeShop,
	tutorial = probeTutorial,
	rebirth = probeRebirth,
	board = probeBoard,
}

local busy = false
req.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
	local feature: string? = nil
	local token: any = nil
	for _, a in ipairs({ ... }) do
		if type(a) == "string" and featureSet[a] and feature == nil then
			feature = a
		elseif token == nil then
			token = a
		end
	end
	if not feature or busy then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local probe = probes[feature :: string]
		local ok, data = pcall(probe)
		busy = false
		if not ok then
			data = { error = tostring(data) }
		end
		res:FireServer(feature, data, token)
	end)
end)
```
